exposure: HPD without pressure vs HPD with pressure
ultrasound assessment of fetal head position and station
Fetal position from digital examination vs ultrasound
cohort: Singleton pregnancies at ≥34 weeks gestation undergoing operative vaginal delivery
finding: Ultrasound assessment of fetal head position and station before operative vaginal delivery moderately predicts difficult operative vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Ultrasound assessment of posterior or transverse positions and HPD with a threshold of 37 mm (without compression of soft tissue) and 17 mm (with compression) were factors associated with difficult operative vaginal delivery.
